summary: Randolph County, AL 'Tin Shop Tower' built by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1949 or 1950 (NHLR sources differ); NHLR-registered 2009 as US 861. Current condition not confirmed.

facts.status_note: The Register does not say whether the tower still stands or what condition it is in; the 'standing' status in our record is not confirmed by any source read

events.note: Built field lists 1950; the NHLR description says the Alabama Forestry Commission constructed it in 1949
Registered January 7, 2009 as US 861, AL 39; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.supports: constructed by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1949 (description)
evidence.quote: Potash Lookout Tower was constructed by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1949

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR Built field gives 1950, while the NHLR description says the Alabama Forestry Commission constructed the tower in 1949. The record keeps the Built field year; the story reports both and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and a general 1819 News profile were read. A search surfaced an unnamed lookout tower on TopoQuest near the NHLR coordinates (about 1,318 ft), with no builder, name or agency link, so it was not used. A search for the Tin Shop name turned up only a volunteer fire department of that name in Roanoke, with no link to this tower. The 1949/1950 conflict is inside the Register and is unresolved. Status, staffing and access are unconfirmed.
